research_change.notes: AFTER materially changes the OAuth/DCR setup: it replaces the opaque issuer value with the stable base auth URL https://auth.atlassian.com, removes the prior manual issuer/discovery fallback, and requires Use Discovered because DCR is established through the protected-resource discovery chain rather than base-issuer metadata. It also adds provenance-backed verification of the authorization, token, and registration endpoints and hedges the app-policy path instead of prescribing installation. These changes require re-drafting speakeasy.md and may affect external.md; the remote URL, transport, anchors, callback, and catalog conditionals remain unchanged.
